## Nettoyage de la base Open street map
```{r}
restos_brut <- st_read(here("restaurant.geojson"))

restos <- restos_brut |> 
  select(`name`,`amenity`,`cuisine`,`diet.vegan`,`diet.vegetarian`,`geometry`)
```

## Nettoyage de la bases des contours administratifs
```{r}
communes_brut <- st_read(here("contours_communes.geojson"))
communes <- communes_brut |> 
  select(`nom`,`geometry`)
```
